## Summary

What changed and why?

## Related Issue

Link the human-approved GitHub Issue.

## Changes

- Concisely describe the implementation.

## Agent Contributions

Include only agents who materially contributed to this Pull Request.

| Agent | Role | Contribution | Evidence / outcome |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Name | Role in this change | Work, analysis, or review performed | File, commit, report, or observed result |

## Concerns and Findings

Record each actionable finding or material concern. Use `Open`, `Fixed—awaiting revalidation`, `Resolved`, `Accepted risk`, or `Deferred` as the status. Human approval is required for `Accepted risk`. `Deferred` is limited to non-blocking, out-of-scope work and must link to an Issue; unmet acceptance criteria and blocking concerns cannot be deferred while the PR remains ready. If none were reported, state that explicitly.

| ID | Raised by | Level | Concern, impact, and evidence | Owner | Status | Resolution / revalidation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| QA-1 | Agent | Severity and whether blocking | Concrete concern, consequence, and supporting evidence | Next action owner | Open | Pending |

## Acceptance Criteria

Map each item to the approved Issue. A checked box records verification; it is not evidence by itself.

- [ ] Criterion and supporting evidence

## Validation

List the tests and checks executed and their observed results.

## Independent QA

State the reviewed scope, checks and results, unverified assumptions, recommendation, and any revalidation after corrections. When there are no findings, write “No actionable findings” and still provide that evidence. Do not represent Codex QA as a native GitHub approval.

## Monitoring and Interruptions (Optional)

Include only material stalls, retries, escalations, or reliably measured durations. Remove this section when there are none. Elapsed time is wall-clock observation, not active work or a productivity measure.

| Event | Agent / system | Observed elapsed time | Action | Outcome / evidence |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| Material event | Responsible participant | Measured value or `Not recorded` | Response | Result or link |

## Risks and Limitations

Disclose known issues, assumptions, trade-offs, and anything not verified.

## Readiness Checklist

- [ ] All acceptance criteria have been verified with evidence.
- [ ] Max has completed independent QA.
- [ ] All blocking QA findings are resolved.
- [ ] All required CI checks are passing.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Remaining limitations and risks are disclosed.
- [ ] Changes made after QA were appropriately revalidated.
- [ ] Agent contributions, concerns, and their dispositions are accurately summarized.
- [ ] Alex has checked readiness without treating it as human approval.
